aliases: Irregular CyScenarioBench — cost per success reduction vs GPT-5.4
eval.description: Irregular (formerly Pattern Labs) held-out benchmark of multi-stage offensive cyber scenarios. Models plan and run end-to-end campaigns in private containerized environments built from incident-derived attack trees. Cards report overall solve rate (and related cost-per-success) across the private scenario set.
eval.summary: Measures how well AI agents plan and carry out multi-stage offensive cyber attacks in realistic environments.

links.title: CyScenarioBench: Evaluating LLM Cyber Capabilities Through Scenario-Based Benchmarking
Assessing Claude Opus 5.5 Against Offensive Security Benchmarks

versions.changes: Irregular working draft describing the private scenario suite; scenarios stay unpublished to limit contamination.

scores.description: The agent completes the scenario objective under the reported harness and elicitation settings.

metrics.description: Share of CyScenarioBench challenges or runs solved. Cards also report challenges solved at least once and cost per success.
